description: A React component that provides a rich text editor page for creating and editing blog posts, with features like auto-save, publish/unpublish, delete, image upload, and live post data subscription.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounce wrapper around a callback function to limit how often it is invoked.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures that a post exists by creating one if necessary, and returns the post ID.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Handles uploading an image file and returns its URL.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the editor content and triggers a debounced save.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the post title input and triggers a debounced save.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Performs an explicit save of the current post, showing an alert upon success or failure.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the publish status of the post.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post after confirmation.
